name: Noria
note: The world's manifest (docs/plans/order-plan.md, sprint D). `show` is MapShow, read by game/world/world_show.cpp: what the client draws, plays and hears here. A system opens only where its field is set. Copied to assets/world/<w>/world.json by pipeline/sync.sh.

rules.note: The Golden Dragon invades here, on its own clock (sim/invasion.h; OpenMU VersionSeasonSix InvasionMobsInitialization.cs:74-101): Lorencia first, Devias and Noria since 2026-10-08 (the user: 'dragon can land on devias,lorencia,noria').

air.note: No wind: its jungle bed is the whole of its air (the user, 2026-09-29).

music.note: MUSIC_NORIA in its safe zone (SceneManager.cpp:1028-1036; the user, 2026-10-05).

boids.note: MODEL_BUTTERFLY01 (MapManager.cpp:89; GOBoid.cpp:1335: Velocity 0.3, LightEnable false, Light 1). 6.25: the cook's 0.25 s keys over MU's 0.04 s.

npcs.name: Peia
npcs.note: Ours, not Version075's: the elf's quest giver. MuMain's MONSTER_ELF_SOLDIER, whom its Korean client names Peia, in the flower bed under the town's great tree where the user put her (2026-09-29) -- OpenMU Season Six stands her four tiles west, at 167,118.

npcs.name: Charon
npcs.note: Ours: Charon (237), Devil Square's gatekeeper, where 0.95d stands him (Version095d/Maps/Noria.cs:32). 0.75 has no Devil Square; until it is written he says the hero is not ready (the user, 2026-09-30).

npcs.name: Liane the Broker
npcs.note: Ours: the Broker (docs/game/broker.md), beside Baz, in MuMain's Mirage (Npc/mirazu.bmd), the Broker's one figure in all three towns.

npcs.name: Elf Archer
npcs.note: Ours: Noria's watch (the user, 2026-09-29), which neither Version075 nor MuMain has. An archer and a crossbow at each of the town's three roads, a tile outside the safe bit. Every one fights on the Crossbow Guard's row, 247 -- five tiles is a bow's reach as much as a crossbow's -- and the figure says which weapon she draws.

npcs.name: Moss the Gambler
npcs.note: Ours: the Jeweler (rings and pendants: Recut, Salvage, Combine), the user's pick 2026-10-20, on the east market beside Potion Girl Amy, facing the plaza. MuMain's MONSTER_MOSS_THE_MERCHANT (492), Elbeland's gambler in later seasons; not Version075's. His window is not built yet.

exits.note: Atlans's and Noria's, Gates.cs:135 and 148-149 (docs/worlds/atlans-port.md A §2.1). 48 is Direction.North (7), (-1,+1), into Noria and away from gate 45 beside it; 46 is Direction.South (3), (+1,-1), into the basin and away from gate 47; 49 is the spawn gate, the safe basin, with no direction: a death and the Town Portal land there. Noria, from Atlans
Noria, back from Aida, with no direction (OpenMU VersionSeasonSix Gates.cs:170).

enters.note: Gates.cs:205-206: Noria's far south-east corner to Atlans, and the basin's corner back, both level 60 in every source (OM 075, WebZen's official gate.txt; docs/worlds/atlans-port.md A §2.2). The user, 2026-10-04: 'lets migrate noria -> atlans gates and add lvl requirments for gates'. Then 'increase lvl requirment to 120', and back down to 70 once the monsters' 43-74 showed 120 made the map trivial ('gate back toward 60-70'): the way in asks 70, ours, Season Six's Atlans warp level; the way out keeps MU's 60. Noria to Atlans
And Charon's into Devil Square 1 (sim/square.h kSquareEnterGate), from Noria.

Noria's door to Aida (OpenMU VersionSeasonSix Gates.cs:534; docs/worlds/aida-port.md). MU asks 130; ours 300, Aida a late-game place (the user, 2026-10-11: 'lets ask LVL 300 its a late game activity'), 200 for the Magic Gladiator, who pays two thirds.

spawn.note: OpenMU's spawn gate 27: the box a new character starts in and a dead one stands up in, the .mur's safe gate (pipeline/index.py gate_rows). rules.arrive is its middle. Out of mu.db's gates table in sprint D6.
